create_fakeagent_for_testing: create a FakeAgent instance with a mock world to test Minecraft agent behavior in a controlled environment
test_dig_action: test the Dig action class to verify block digging updates changed blocks and world state correctly
test_movement_actions: test StepPosX, StepNegX, StepPosZ, StepNegZ, StepPosY, StepNegY actions to verify agent position updates

test_draw_slice_visualization: test the draw_slice method to render a 2D map slice of the world around the agent position
